name: I wanna be her
source:
Someone ends up in the bottom of a dry well; in there they can hear a voice making them a offer. “I let you out, you give me your ▊▋█▌▍▊▋█▌▍”

Maybe after enough time paying w̶h̶a̶t̶e̶v̶e̶r̶ wouldn’t sound too bad.

And maybe coming back can tell you something.

[From [url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/i-wanna-be-her]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有人最终落入干井底部；在那里他们可以听到一个声音向他们提出要约。“我放你出去，你把你的▊▋█▌▍▊▋█▌▍”

也许经过足够的时间支付w̶h̶a̶t̶e̶v̶e̶r̶ 听起来不会太糟糕。

也许回来可以告诉你一些事情。

[来自[url=https://taumilicorice.itch.io/i-wanna-be-her]Itch.io[/url]]
